text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I'm super nervous about thenext test... But I have to make sure Ipass!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I've got it! Maybe I can turn my study<n>materials
into a song!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I'm the best when it comes to<n>songwriting!
☆ I'll start with a song<n>about history, another about
science,<n>and then finish with a short poem by<n>me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I bet it'd be super popular with other<n>people who
suck at studying! It might<n>even make it to number
one on the<n>charts. ☆
